Public domain: every person whose words are in this text died in 1925 or earlier, so the term has ended under the law of every country, whichever one first published it.

People: Dorothée Dino (author, Wikidata Q271719), died 1862; Marie Dorothea Elisabeth de Castellane Radziwill (editor, Wikidata Q454204), died 1915. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Dino, Dorothée, duchesse de, 1793-1862; Radziwill, Marie Dorothea Elisabeth de Castellane, Fürstin, 1840-1915 [Editor]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Chronique de 1831 à 1862, publiée avec des annotations et un index biographique par la princesse Radziwill, née Castellane, Paris Plon-Nourrit, 1909, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/chroniquede183101dinouoft. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 94%, 93%, 61% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Marie Dorothea Elisabeth de Castellane Radziwill, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
